title: Lead record (v1)
description: One element of the leads array returned by ingest_leads. The full name and the profile URL of a person appear in no field; the profile URL survives only as the slug inside profile_key.

lead_id.description: Sequential, continuing after the highest L<digits> id among existing_leads; unique only relative to the existing_leads passed.

profile_key.description: The identity of a lead: platform id, a colon and the lower-cased profile slug.

reasons.description: Awarded components in rubric order, or exclusion_hit:<term> entries only.

source_query.description: Always the query id, also when the row named the query by its search_url.
